name: Sumire no Tsubomi Fan Disc ~Wedding Daisakusen~
original_name: すみれの蕾 fan disc～ウェディング大作戦～
source: A fandisc of Sumire no Tsubomi. Wedding Daisakusen features slice-of-life scenearios of your time together with the hero of your choosing. Unlike the original, instead of making selections to end up with the desired hero, players are able to choose which character stories they would like to view in a categorised list. Previously support-only characters have been given their own scenarios.
translation: 《Sumire no Tsubomi》的粉丝向光盘。《Wedding Daisakusen》收录玩家与所选男主角共同度过的日常故事。与原作不同，玩家无需不断作出选择以进入心仪男主角的路线，而是可以从分类列表中直接选择想阅读的角色故事。此前仅担任配角的人物也获得了各自的专属篇章。
